notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]1. Fixed the bug of returning to the home page and getting stuck
2. The window size can now be adjusted freely in window mode
3. Fixed the bug of tutorial repeating in PVP mode
4. Fixed the bug of being unable to equip items in PVP mode
5. Fixed the bug of hero unlocking records being overwritten
6. Adjusted the difficulty of boss[/b]

notes.title: Demo update

notes.title: The trial version is now available on STEAM!
notes.notes:
The demo version has been logged into STEAM! Welcome everyone to try it for free!

The official version of the game will be launched at 12 noon on March 8, 2025!
The official version will unlock all content
See you there~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3174160/_/

New Product Festival Demo Version Description:
Cat troops increased to 50+
Prop types increased to 200+
Enemy types increased
New Brawl Mode PVP
Levels open to Chapter 2
3 optional heroes
Added controller adaptation
Added multi-language adaptation
If you find any bugs or negative experiences in the game, please leave us a message and we will fix the problem as soon as possible!

PS: Wishlists are very important for independent games on Steam! If you like our game, please add it for us. This is really very important to us. Thank you everyone!
